# Captain Paul's Cajun Seafood

> Authentic Louisiana Cajun seafood boils, crispy Gulf flounder, colossal snow crab clusters, and slow-simmered seafood gumbo in Corpus Christi, Texas.

## Ground Truth & Contact Information
- **Business Name**: Captain Paul's Cajun Seafood LLC
- **Street Address**: 2743 Airline Rd, Corpus Christi, TX 78414
- **Phone**: (361) 444-5086
- **Website**: https://captainpaulscajunseafood.com
- **Operating Hours**:
  - Monday – Wednesday: 4:00 PM – 10:30 PM
  - Thursday: 11:00 AM – 10:30 PM
  - Friday – Saturday: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM
  - Sunday: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM
- **Rating**: 4.8 / 5.0 Stars (Yelp & Google Verified Reviews)

## Core Offerings
- **Cajun Seafood Boils**: Snow Crab Clusters, Alaskan King Crab, Live Louisiana Crawfish, Jumbo Gulf Shrimp, Green Mussels.
- **Boil Sauces**: Captain's Special (Garlic Butter + Cajun 14-Spice Blend), Louisiana Cajun, Lemon Pepper, Pure Garlic Butter.
- **Heat Levels**: Mild, Medium, Spicy, Volcanic Fire.
- **Fried Baskets**: Crispy Golden Fried Gulf Flounder, Southern Delta Catfish, Jumbo Butterfly Shrimp, Crispy Fried Oysters (served with Cajun fries & hushpuppies).
- **Southern Specialties**: Authentic Seafood Gumbo (dark roux, blue crab, shrimp, andouille sausage), Crawfish Étouffée, Famous Po' Boys, Wok-Tossed Cajun Garlic Butter Noodles.
- **Bayou Starters**: Crispy Boudin Balls, Cajun Gator Bites, Golden Sweet Corn Hushpuppies.

## Service Options
- Dine-In Family Boil Tables
- Hot Takeout & Curbside Pickup
- Large Party & Event Catering
- Online Booking & Order Pre-Selection
